programs.title: Bearer Token Auth Client
programs.description: Reads a URL and JWT token from stdin, adds Authorization: Bearer header, and prints the API response.
programs.input_format: First line: URL. Second line: JWT token
programs.output_format: Status code and JSON response body

programs.title: Login and Token Flow Client
programs.description: Reads a login URL, username, and password from stdin. POSTs credentials, extracts JWT from response, then calls a protected endpoint using the token.
programs.input_format: First line: login URL. Second line: protected URL. Third line: username. Fourth line: password
programs.output_format: Login status, token (truncated), and protected endpoint response

programs.title: Token Refresh Client
programs.description: Reads base URL, access token, and refresh token from stdin. Calls a protected endpoint; if 401, uses refresh endpoint to get a new token and retries.
programs.input_format: First line: base URL. Second line: access token. Third line: refresh token
programs.output_format: Response from protected endpoint; logs if token was refreshed

programs.title: Polling Client with Backoff
programs.description: Reads a URL and expected condition (e.g. status=200) from stdin. Polls the URL repeatedly with exponential backoff until condition is met or timeout.
programs.input_format: First line: URL. Second line: max wait seconds. Third line: expected HTTP status
programs.output_format: Logs each poll attempt with timestamp; final PASS or FAIL

programs.title: Content-Type Negotiating Client
programs.description: Reads a URL and preferred format (json|xml|text) from stdin. Sends the appropriate Accept header and prints the response body.
programs.input_format: First line: URL. Second line: preferred format
programs.output_format: Response body; logs actual Content-Type returned

programs.title: TCP Echo Client
programs.description: Reads a host, port, and messages from stdin. Opens a raw TCP connection, sends each message followed by newline, and prints received responses.
programs.input_format: First line: host. Second line: port. Subsequent lines: messages (blank to finish)
programs.output_format: Server response per sent message; 'Connection closed' at end

programs.title: SOAP/XML API Client
programs.description: Reads a SOAP endpoint URL and operation name from stdin. Constructs a SOAP envelope, sends the request, and parses the XML response into a readable format.
programs.input_format: First line: SOAP URL. Second line: operation name. Third line: XML body fragment
programs.output_format: Parsed response fields; raw XML if parsing fails
programs.source: m=soapclient;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=main():$i64{let url=io.readln();let opname=s.trim(io.readln());let body=io.readln();let inta=mut.0;let intb=mut.0;if(s.contains(body;"<intA>")){let p1=s.split(body;"<intA>");if(p1.len()>=2){let rest=p1.get(1);let p2=s.split(rest;"<");if(p2.len()>=1){inta=s.toint(s.trim(p2.get(0)))}}};if(s.contains(body;"<intB>")){let q1=s.split(body;"<intB>");if(q1.len()>=2){let rest2=q1.get(1);let q2=s.split(rest2;"<");if(q2.len()>=1){intb=s.toint(s.trim(q2.get(0)))}}};let result=mut.0;if(opname="Add"){result=inta+intb};if(opname="Multiply"){result=inta*intb};if(opname="Subtract"){result=inta-intb};io.println(s.fromint(result));<0}
